description: This file contains utility functions for reading the contents of a file into memory and printing input/output data related to unit tests. It includes implementations for reading a file into a memory buffer, handling errors during file operations, and printing the file contents alongside some KVP data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a provided memory buffer, returning 0 on success or -1 on failure.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (read into memory) and KVP data if provided.
